review_notes: Read the whole file and the in-repo uses (ModuleEquivalence.lean, Length.lean, tests). I did not run Lean, so the competing-rule claim is by reasoning about simp's bottom-up rewriting order, not an observed failure. The refl lemma looks fine, since it fires on the inner OrderIso before the coercion lemma. The missing simp attribute on trans is a minor point and I did not report it.

findings.problem: Both coercion lemmas are tagged @[simp] and rewrite an abstract order-isomorphism application into a large explicit range expression. Simp rewrites subterms first, so this expansion competes with the generic OrderIso simp lemmas. In `φ (φ.symm P)`, `φ.symm P` is expanded first, so `OrderIso.apply_symm_apply` no longer matches. In `φ.symm (φ N)`, `φ N` is expanded first and `symm_apply_apply` no longer matches. `φ ⊤`, `φ ⊥` and `φ (N ⊔ N')` are also unfolded into `range (map (ofHom (⊤ : Submodule R X).subtype))` before `map_top`, `map_bot` or `map_sup` can fire. The result is a larger term that is not a normal form. The existing uses avoid simp for this reason: ModuleEquivalence uses `simpa only [φ.map_top]` and the tests use `simpa only [map_bot]` / `[map_top]`.
findings.proposed_change: Drop @[simp] from `submoduleOrderIsoOfEquivalence_apply` and `submoduleOrderIsoOfEquivalence_symm_apply`, and use them only with explicit `rw` or `simp only`. Keep the OrderIso API (`apply_symm_apply`, `symm_apply_apply`, `map_top`, `map_bot`, `map_sup`) as the default simp normal form. If a simp-form unfolding is wanted, put it in a separate non-default simp set. Consider also tagging `submoduleOrderIsoOfEquivalence_trans` @[simp] so composites normalize through `OrderIso.trans`.
findings.benefit: `simp` on submodule-lattice transport goals would keep `φ`/`φ.symm` round trips and the lattice-hom lemmas available. It would not turn them into nested `LinearMap.range (functor.map (ofHom …subtype))` terms that can't be recognised again. Proofs of finiteness and length statements could then use plain `simp` instead of the `simpa only [...]` workarounds.

evidence.excerpt: simpa only [φ.map_top] using φ.isCompactElement_iff (⊤ : Submodule R X)
